features.name: Find Broken Links, Errors & Redirects
features.detail: HTTP errors, redirects, chains, loops and broken outlinks implemented. JavaScript redirects and all refresh variants remain pending.

features.name: Analyse Page Titles & Meta Data
features.detail: HTML metadata, headings, lengths and duplicates; browser-measured pixel columns use our own font settings, with original metric parity unverified.

features.name: Review Meta Robots & Directives
features.detail: HTML/HTTP robots directives and local indexability assessment.

features.name: Audit hreflang Attributes
features.detail: Extraction, language syntax, return links and known-target errors. Full original rule catalogue not matched.

features.name: Discover Exact Duplicate Pages
features.detail: Normalized text hashing and metadata duplicate detection.

features.name: Generate XML Sitemaps
features.detail: Indexable-page XML sitemap available; image sitemaps and automatic multi-file indexes pending.

features.name: Site Visualisations
features.detail: D3 crawl-link graph and directory graph implemented. Browser smoke check on 2026-10-23 rendered the saved site's graph with 385 nodes and 7679 links and switched to directory mode. Full original visualization catalogue and algorithm parity remain unestablished.

features.name: Crawl Limit
features.detail: No commercial URL ceiling. Configurable total/external limits accept 0 for unlimited. External checking is opt-in and does not recurse. Tests cover 506 internal pages and 205 direct external targets.

features.name: Scheduling
features.detail: Persistent local scheduler API and scheduling dialog implemented. Creation and deletion verified through the browser on 2026-10-23; test schedule removed. Server must remain running; execution while the machine is off is not supported.

features.name: Crawl Configuration
features.detail: Concurrency, delays, scope, resources, user-agent, headers, robots and limits. Full original configuration catalogue, proxy and Digest pending.

features.name: Save & Open Crawls
features.detail: Automatic SQLite persistence, history, recovery and resume; recovery tests pass.

features.name: JavaScript Rendering
features.detail: Real Chromium/Edge/Chrome rendering, sources, screenshots, resources, errors and custom JavaScript.

features.name: Crawl Comparison
features.detail: Added/removed URLs, field changes and introduced/resolved issues implemented. Staging/production URL mapping pending.

features.name: Near Duplicate Content
features.detail: Jaccard shingles, currently up to 1000 nonempty documents and 10000 words/document. Remove this analysis sampling limit with a scalable candidate algorithm before declaring Pro parity. Embeddings pending.

features.name: Custom robots.txt
features.detail: Custom rules, host-specific fetched rules, Crawl-delay and accurate separation of blocked URLs versus unavailable robots.

features.name: Mobile Usability
features.detail: Real Lighthouse 13.5.0 mobile audits implemented and smoke-tested with 155 audit records. Original mobile filters and full UI parity pending.

features.name: AMP Crawling & Validation
features.detail: AMP discovery and optional official amphtml-validator. Real validator smoke test rejects invalid AMP with three errors.

features.name: Structured Data & Validation
features.detail: JSON-LD extraction and syntax validation. Full Schema.org/rich-results validation, Microdata and RDFa pending.

features.name: Spelling & Grammar Checks
features.detail: Chunked LanguageTool connector checks all supplied text. A local LanguageTool server or user-configured service is required; tests used a local mocked API, not the real linguistic engine.

features.name: Custom Source Code Search
features.detail: Crawls search the complete fetched HTML in an isolated 128 MiB worker with a 2-second deadline. Explicit timeout and result-coverage diagnostics; up to 100 retained matches of 16384 characters each. Restricted regex syntax remains; full reference parity is unverified.

features.name: Custom Extraction
features.detail: CSS, XPath and restricted regex extraction; full original expression and malformed-HTML compatibility not established.

features.name: Custom JavaScript
features.detail: Explicit user snippets execute in the crawling browser, with results and errors attributed to each URL.

features.name: Crawl with OpenAI & Gemini
features.detail: OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic and local Ollama connectors implemented and mocked. Real accounts/models, quotas and payments remain external.

features.name: Google Analytics Integration
features.detail: GA4 bearer-token connector with pagination implemented; real property access and full metric selection not validated.

features.name: Search Console Integration
features.detail: Search Analytics pagination implemented. URL Inspection, OAuth refresh and full metric catalogue pending.

features.name: PageSpeed Insights Integration
features.detail: PSI/Lighthouse result connector implemented; real API/account smoke check pending.

features.name: Accessibility Auditing
features.detail: Real axe-core runs on rendered pages; violations, incomplete results and passing rules retained.

features.name: Link Metrics Integration
features.detail: Majestic, Ahrefs and Moz connectors not yet implemented. Provider accounts/API entitlements required.

features.name: Forms Based Authentication
features.detail: Same-origin login form with configurable selectors; session cookies shared with HTTP crawler. End-to-end login test passes and credentials are not persisted.

features.name: Segmentation
features.detail: Overlapping URL-regex segments, counts and filtering implemented. Full original segmentation conditions/UI pending.

features.name: Looker Studio Crawl Report
features.detail: Dedicated reporting dataset and Looker Studio connector/template pending.

features.name: Free Technical Support
features.detail: Manufacturer support is a vendor service, not functionality copied by this code. A support policy for this independent project has not been established.
